html:
First of all I want to thank all my fans for your support.  We are finally only a day out from the launch of Once Dead.  For those of you who participated in my Beta Reader program or those who will read it shortly, I would very much appreciate it if you take a couple of minutes to rate it on Amazon and post a short review of the novel.  It really does help others to find it.
Thanks again.

Best,
Richard

comments.author: Xin Li
comments.html: I’ve forgotten how much I loved the Rho Agenda universe, until I read this book. I don’t know how you do it. But you pulled me right back in with this latest installment. How many Jack books are you planning to write? And will we ever see another story about Mark, Jennifer and Heather? Surely their story isn’t over yet.

comments.author: Richard Phillips
comments.html: Thank you. I am doing three Jack and Janet prequels that end up explaining exactly what Anchanchu is and how Jack finally gets his act together enough to lead the special NSA team that eventually shows up in Los Alamos in The Second Ship. After that I plan on doing a few novels that follow up on the characters and the changed world(s) from The Rho Agenda trilogy.

replies.html:
